summary: Banzai International filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval and filing of a Certificate of Amendment to effect a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of its Class A and Class B common stock. The split was approved by holders of ~40.52% voting power and filed on April 28, 2026. Pre-split shares outstanding: 22,910,282 (Class A) and 677,118 (Class B); post-split: 1,145,515 and 33,856. No fractional shares; fractions rounded up. Trading on Nasdaq Capital Market continues under symbol "BNZI" with a new CUSIP. No fractional cash. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation; category is None.
